text:
Alex Kim: quick thought — propose an 'evidence ribbon' pinned to the rollout header. compact by default, expands to an evidence bundle with sampled events and a lightweight rationale.

Nora Patel: +1. default view: [mode] [friendly reason] [sampled 1% (12/1200)] and a tiny "why" pill that on hover shows a micro-breakdown.

Chris Wang: API sketch: GET /api/rollouts/:id/audit returns a summary and sampled pointers. example payload (schema sketch):

{"computed_reason":"high_503_rate","raw_reasons":[{"code":503,"count":112},{"code":"timeout","count":24}],"sampled_fraction":0.01,"sampling_meta":{"policy_id":"uniform_v1","seed":"0xdeadbeef"},"sampled_ids":["evt_1","evt_2"]}

Samir Rao: storage tradeoff: compute summary at write-time, persist counts + sampled pointers for 30d; redact request bodies by default. "view raw" requires IAM role=auditor and a KMS pointer for retrieval.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: rollout r-20260601-09 triggered auto-fallback -> mode: graceful_degrade, computed_reason: high_503_rate, sampled: 6/600, operator: Chris W

Nora Patel: UX microcopy options:
1) "Fell back to lower-latency model due to elevated 503s (1% sampled)."
2) "Automatic fallback: high 5xx rate — evidence sampled."
Prefer #1.

Alex Kim: RFC checklist: redaction rules, retention=30d for sampled details, sampling contract (seed + deterministic ids), compute-on-write, API schema, IAM gating. @Chris open a draft PR, @Nora attach mocks.

Chris Wang: will do. I'll prototype schema + tests for deterministic sampling ids and redaction.

Alex Kim: thanks — adding to the sprint board :shipit:
